description.zh: 应用ID，在控制台的**应用管理**页面中获取。
description.en: The ID of the application. You can obtain the application ID on the **Application Management** page in the SchedulerX console.

description.zh: 任务ID，在控制台的**任务管理**页面中获取。
description.en: The ID of the job. You can obtain the ID on the **Task Management** page in the SchedulerX console.

description.zh: 命名空间ID，在控制台的**命名空间**页面中获取。
description.en: The ID of the namespace. You can obtain the ID of the namespace on the **Namespace** page in the SchedulerX console.

description.zh: 特殊第三方才需要填写。
description.en: The source of the namespace. This parameter is required only for a special third party.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun schedulerx2 delete-job --job-id 92583 --namespace adcfc35d-e2fe-4fe9-bbaa-20e90ffc0000 --namespace-source schedulerx --group-id testSchedulerx.defaultGroup --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
